description:
PROBLEM: tests/unit/mcp/test_mcp_tool_handlers.py::TestRunBenchmarkToolSuccess::test_export_failure_does_not_break_response (15 s CI, 38.7 s local plus 17.9 s GC) never reaches its own mocks: the result object is a MagicMock from the patched platform adapter, and building the result payload recurses through it to Python's recursion limit (1.9 M mock calls). It is slow and does not verify what its name says.

CHANGE: rebuild the test so a real result object reaches the response builder and the export step is made to fail; assert the response is still built and reports the export failure as the test intends. Preferred: call the response builder (_build_run_response or its public equivalent) with a real BenchmarkResults-like object built by an existing fixture or factory; alternative: patch build_result_payload. Remove the unused mocks.

DECISION GATES:
G1 Identify from git log/blame what the test was added to protect; the rewrite must assert that exact property.
G2 C2: break the error handling (let the export exception propagate) and show the rewritten test fails; show the current test still passes under the same break (proving it was vacuous) or explain.
G3 No real platform connection or network.
